# Diamond facets and public API

This is the human-readable reference for the current production Diamond surface.
It is generated from [`selectors/diamond.json`](../../selectors/diamond.json) and
[`abi/Diamond.json`](../../abi/Diamond.json); Solidity source and tests remain
authoritative for semantics and authorization details.

## Current deployment

The application endpoint is the Diamond, never an individual facet address.
The address below is the committed Sepolia snapshot; integrations must pin the
exact deployment artifact they use.

| Network | Chain ID | Diamond | Artifact timestamp |
| --- | ---: | --- | --- |
| sepolia | 11155111 | [0x1170d2D322Ff2cCeb20e6E79D2b3D2dfABFe6372](../../deployments/sepolia-latest.json) | 2026-08-09T21:39:06.000Z |
| Mainnet | 1 | — | No committed mainnet snapshot |

The deployment script recognizes `sepolia` and `mainnet`; the repository does
not claim a mainnet address until a reviewed artifact is committed.

## Facet map

The manifest contains 28 facets and 201 public functions.
The selector manifest also lists internal routing functions and explicitly
forbidden legacy selectors; those are not callable public API.

| Facet | Public functions | Responsibility / primary use case |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| DiamondCutFacet | 1 | Upgrades the Diamond selector routing (owner-only). |
| DiamondLoupeFacet | 5 | Inspects facet addresses and selector routing. |
| OwnershipFacet | 4 | Reads and transfers Diamond ownership. |
| InitFacet | 1 | Initializes protocol-wide metadata and role configuration. |
| ProviderFacet | 15 | Onboards providers, profiles, roles and provider network status. |
| ServiceCreditFacet | 16 | Mints and moves the internal lot-tracked service-credit ledger. |
| IntentRegistryFacet | 6 | Registers and exposes one-time EIP-712 intents and lifecycle state. |
| InstitutionFacet | 4 | Atomically onboards and revokes institutional wallets. |
| InstitutionalOrgRegistryFacet | 14 | Maps normalized organization identifiers to institutions and backend URLs. |
| InstitutionalTreasuryFacet | 18 | Manages institutional backend delegation, limits and treasury spending. |
| LabFacet | 27 | Provides ERC-721 lab ownership, listing and core lab operations. |
| LabAdminFacet | 7 | Creates, updates and administers labs with creator identity checks. |
| LabIntentFacet | 7 | Executes lab administration through registered intents. |
| LabQueryFacet | 11 | Reads lab configuration, availability and paginated lab state. |
| LabReputationFacet | 6 | Reads and updates provider/lab reputation state. |
| ProviderSettlementFacet | 18 | Builds and settles provider receivable claims. |
| InstitutionalReservationRequestValidationFacet | 1 | Validates institutional reservation request constraints. |
| InstitutionalReservationRequestCreationFacet | 2 | Creates pending institutional reservation requests. |
| InstitutionalReservationConfirmationFacet | 1 | Confirms a pending institutional reservation request. |
| InstitutionalReservationCancellationFacet | 4 | Cancels pending or confirmed institutional reservations. |
| InstitutionalReservationQueryFacet | 14 | Reads institutional reservation and allocation state. |
| InstitutionalReservationFacet | 1 | Shared reservation creation route used by internal Diamond routing. |
| ReservationCheckInFacet | 4 | Records provider-authorized reservation check-in evidence. |
| ReservationStatsFacet | 5 | Reads reservation counters and aggregate statistics. |
| ReservationDenialFacet | 2 | Denies pending reservation requests with provider authority. |
| ReservationIntentFacet | 2 | Executes institutional reservation request and direct-booking intents. |
| ReservationIntentCancellationFacet | 2 | Executes reservation-request and booking cancellation intents. |
| ReservationSessionFacet | 3 | Reads and records the SessionStarted evidence used by access flows. |

## EIP-712 intent signing

Intent registration signs `IntentMeta` in the `DecentraLabsIntent` domain.
The payload is hashed separately and placed in `payloadHash`; it is not a
nested field in the signed meta object. The domain therefore binds the chain
and the Diamond address, while the payload hash binds the operation data.

```javascript
const domain = {
  name: "DecentraLabsIntent",
  version: "1",
  chainId: 11155111,
  verifyingContract: "0x1170d2D322Ff2cCeb20e6E79D2b3D2dfABFe6372",
};

const metaTypes = {
  IntentMeta: [
    { name: "requestId", type: "bytes32" },
    { name: "signer", type: "address" },
    { name: "executor", type: "address" },
    { name: "action", type: "uint8" },
    { name: "payloadHash", type: "bytes32" },
    { name: "nonce", type: "uint256" },
    { name: "requestedAt", type: "uint64" },
    { name: "expiresAt", type: "uint64" },
  ],
};

const reservationPayloadTypes = {
  ReservationIntentPayload: [
    { name: "executor", type: "address" },
    { name: "schacHomeOrganization", type: "string" },
    { name: "pucHash", type: "bytes32" },
    { name: "assertionHash", type: "bytes32" },
    { name: "labId", type: "uint256" },
    { name: "start", type: "uint32" },
    { name: "end", type: "uint32" },
    { name: "price", type: "uint96" },
    { name: "reservationKey", type: "bytes32" },
  ],
};

const actionPayloadTypes = {
  ActionIntentPayload: [
    { name: "executor", type: "address" },
    { name: "schacHomeOrganization", type: "string" },
    { name: "pucHash", type: "bytes32" },
    { name: "assertionHash", type: "bytes32" },
    { name: "labId", type: "uint256" },
    { name: "reservationKey", type: "bytes32" },
    { name: "uri", type: "string" },
    { name: "price", type: "uint96" },
    { name: "maxBatch", type: "uint96" },
    { name: "accessURI", type: "string" },
    { name: "accessKey", type: "string" },
    { name: "tokenURI", type: "string" },
    { name: "resourceType", type: "uint8" },
  ],
};

const payloadHash = ethers.TypedDataEncoder.hashStruct(
  "ReservationIntentPayload",
  reservationPayloadTypes,
  payload,
);
const message = { ...meta, payloadHash };
const signature = await signer.signTypedData(domain, metaTypes, message);
```
Action intents use the same `IntentMeta` type and the `ActionIntentPayload`
fields shown in the example and in `contracts/libraries/IntentTypes.sol`;
hash an action payload with `actionPayloadTypes` before signing `IntentMeta`.
Action codes are 1–11 as
documented in [the intent lifecycle reference](intents.md). The signer must
use the current nonce and an expiry in the future; the executor must match the
transaction sender at consumption time.
